SakuraCord

Discord, at home on the Mac.

SakuraCord is a fast, native Discord client written in SwiftUI, with full voice and video, rich content, and far less overhead than the official app.

Download for MacGitHub

macOS 27 or later

Thu Oct 8  9:41 AM

What SakuraCord does

Thu Oct 8  9:41 AM

  1. Native by design.

    SwiftUI surfaces, real Mac windows, menus, shortcuts and settings, presented in Liquid Glass. No Electron, no Chromium bundle.

  2. Rich Discord content.

    Embeds, Components V2, modals, stickers, GIFs, uploads, custom emoji and slash commands, rendered as native controls.

  3. Voice and video.

    Guild voice and direct calls with native device controls, Opus audio, H.264 video and DAVE support.

  4. Forums, first class.

    Browse posts by tag, sort and filter them, and jump into threads without leaving the window.

  5. Make it yours.

    A theme designer with colour wheels, glass and window opacity. Copy your theme and share it with the server.

Set up in a minute.

Download the latest DMG, open it, and move SakuraCord into Applications. Or install it with Homebrew.

1 Install with Homebrew

brew install --cask SakuraCordApp/tap/sakuracord

2 Approve the first launch

Current releases are ad-hoc signed rather than notarized, so macOS may ask you to approve SakuraCord once in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

3 Sign in and chat

That’s it. Your servers, channels, calls and forums are where Discord put them, inside a real Mac app.
